about.description:
Omicron has been derived from a well-known 'burst-type' search pipeline
called Q-pipeline (a.k.a Omega).  Q-pipeline is able to detect and
characterize detector glitches with a very good efficiency and precision.
So, the idea was to adapt it for detector characterization purposes,
i.e. to run it over many auxiliary channels.  To achieve this, the
original matlab code has been replaced by a C++ architecture and many
steps have been removed to run faster.  The name Omicron was chosen to
recall the Omega inheritance.
about.summary: An algorithm to detect and characterize transient events in gravitational-wave detectors

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 4.1.1
  # Omicron and GWOLLUM are developed in parallel and must be kept in sync
  gwollum_version: "${{ version }}"

package:
  name: omicron
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://git.ligo.org/virgo/virgoapp/Omicron/-/archive/${{ version }}/Omicron-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 526ce0737982c77e46dc89127c03d181e66b9e9c3664987c984e1466578766a8

build:
  number: 9
  skip: win

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake >=3.9.0
    - if: unix
      then:
        - make
        - pkg-config
  host:
    - fftw
    - gwollum ${{ gwollum_version }}.*
    - root_base
    - root_cxx_standard
  run:
    - gwollum ${{ gwollum_version }}.*

tests:
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pkg-config
    script:
      - omicron version
      - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version ${{ version }} omicron
      - if: unix
        then: test "${OMICRON_HTML}" == "${PREFIX}/share/omicron/html"

about:
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: An algorithm to detect and characterize transient events in gravitational-wave detectors
  description: |
    Omicron has been derived from a well-known 'burst-type' search pipeline
    called Q-pipeline (a.k.a Omega).  Q-pipeline is able to detect and
    characterize detector glitches with a very good efficiency and precision.
    So, the idea was to adapt it for detector characterization purposes,
    i.e. to run it over many auxiliary channels.  To achieve this, the
    original matlab code has been replaced by a C++ architecture and many
    steps have been removed to run faster.  The name Omicron was chosen to
    recall the Omega inheritance.
  homepage: https://virgo.docs.ligo.org/virgoapp/Omicron/
  repository: https://git.ligo.org/virgo/virgoapp/Omicron.git
  documentation: https://virgo.docs.ligo.org/virgoapp/Omicron/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - duncanmmacleod
    - FlorentRobinet
